name: Module 1 — Branch Operations Fundamentals
description: A foundational training module for FirstUK Bank branch staff covering core operational procedures, customer service standards, and branch management practices. Designed for tellers, branch managers, and retail banking operations personnel.
context: FirstUK Bank — Branch Operations Training Manual

name: Branch Customer
description: A natural person who visits or interacts with FirstUK Bank branch locations for banking services, account management, or product inquiries. The primary audience for branch staff interactions and service delivery.
context_role: retail banking customer served by branch staff

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The banking organization issuing this branch operations training manual for retail banking staff and branch management.
context: FirstUK Bank — Branch Operations Training Manual

name: Retail Banking Operations
description: The department responsible for branch operations, customer service delivery, and retail banking functions at FirstUK Bank. Owner of this training manual.

name: Branch Daily Operations Training Module
description: A training module designed to equip branch staff with knowledge and skills for executing daily operational tasks, customer service delivery, and branch management standards. The module covers opening procedures and operational protocols essential for branch-level banking operations.
context: Train branch staff on daily operations, customer service, opening procedures, and branch management standards.
module_topic: daily operations, customer service, opening procedures, branch management standards

name: Execute Daily Branch Opening Procedures
description: Staff must be able to perform the complete daily opening procedures for branch operations as part of standard operational readiness.
context: Train branch staff on daily operations, customer service, opening procedures, and branch management standards.

name: Deliver Effective Customer Service
description: Staff must develop competency in delivering customer service as a core operational responsibility within branch daily activities.
context: Train branch staff on daily operations, customer service, opening procedures, and branch management standards.

name: Apply Branch Management Standards
description: Staff must understand and apply the branch management standards that govern operational conduct and service delivery across the branch network.
context: Train branch staff on daily operations, customer service, opening procedures, and branch management standards.

name: Daily Branch Opening Procedures
description: A procedural training module covering the daily opening sequence for branch staff, executed 30 minutes before customer service begins at 09:00 AM. The module encompasses physical security checks, cash handling and vault procedures, system startup verification, and branch readiness confirmation. Staff must complete all four procedural sections in sequence before the branch opens to customers.
module_topic: Branch opening and daily operational readiness

name: Physical Security Check Execution
description: Staff must be able to execute physical security checks including verifying entrance/exit doors are locked, disarming the alarm system, checking for signs of break-in, and activating lights and CCTV systems.
context: Check for any signs of break-in
objective_statement: Staff will be able to perform physical security checks including door locks, alarm disarming, break-in detection, and CCTV activation

name: Cash Handling and Vault Verification
description: Staff must be able to count cash in the vault, verify amounts against overnight reports, load cash drawers to the standard amount, record drawer assignments, and secure the vault.
context: Count cash in vault (report to manager)
Load cash drawers for tellers (standard: £5,000 per drawer)
objective_statement: Staff will be able to count vault cash, verify amounts against overnight reports, load cash drawers with correct amounts, record assignments, and secure the vault

name: Banking System Startup and Access Verification
canonical_name: Banking System Startup and Access Verification
description: Staff must be able to boot up computers, wait for systems to come online, check the system status dashboard for readiness indicators, log into teller systems with credentials, and verify access to customer accounts.
context: Log into teller systems with credentials
Verify ability to access customer accounts
objective_statement: Staff will be able to boot systems, verify system status readiness, log into teller systems, and confirm access to customer accounts

name: Branch Facility and Staff Readiness Confirmation
canonical_name: Branch Facility and Staff Readiness Confirmation
description: Staff must be able to verify the waiting area is suitable for customers, confirm reception and bathroom cleanliness and stocking, load the appointment calendar, and ensure all staff are at their desks by 08:50 AM.
context: Check bathrooms are clean and stocked
Confirm staff are at their desks by 08:50 AM
objective_statement: Staff will be able to verify branch facilities are clean and ready, appointment calendar is loaded, and all staff are present and at desks by required time

name: Cash Drawer Loading and Recording
description: Staff must load cash drawers for tellers to the standard amount of £5,000 per drawer and record all drawer assignments as part of the opening procedure.
context: Load cash drawers for tellers (standard: £5,000 per drawer)
applies_to: branch staff responsible for cash handling
verification_method: manager review of drawer assignment records

name: Vault Cash Count and Manager Reporting
canonical_name: Vault Cash Count and Manager Reporting
description: Staff must count the cash in the vault and report the amount to the manager, then verify it matches the overnight report before proceeding with drawer loading.
context: Count cash in vault (report to manager)
applies_to: branch staff responsible for cash handling

name: System Status Verification Before Customer Access
canonical_name: System Status Verification Before Customer Access
description: Staff must verify that the system status dashboard shows green (ready status) and confirm the ability to access customer accounts before the branch opens to customers.
context: Verify ability to access customer accounts
applies_to: branch staff responsible for system administration

name: During Business Hours Operations Checklist
description: A set of mandatory operational and compliance checks that must be performed during business hours (09:00–17:00), including customer queue monitoring, teller station staffing, cash drawer balance verification, systems monitoring, and KYC/AML procedure adherence for new accounts.
context: Customer queue monitored (>10 people = call backup)
Follow KYC/AML procedures for new accounts

name: Customer Queue Monitoring and Backup Protocol
canonical_name: Customer Queue Monitoring and Backup Protocol
description: Staff must continuously monitor the customer queue during business hours and call backup support when queue length exceeds 10 people to ensure adequate service capacity.
context: Customer queue monitored (>10 people = call backup)

name: Teller Station Staffing Requirement
description: All teller stations must be staffed during business hours as part of hourly operational checks to maintain service delivery standards.

name: Cash Drawer Balance Monitoring
description: Cash drawer balances must be monitored hourly during business hours as part of security and reconciliation procedures.

name: Systems Operational Monitoring
description: Staff must verify that all banking systems are running smoothly during hourly checks to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.

name: Customer Complaint Resolution Obligation
description: Staff must ensure no customer complaints remain pending and must resolve issues professionally during business hours.

name: Customer Greeting Timeframe
description: All customers must be greeted within 2 minutes of arrival as a continuous service standard during business hours.

name: Transaction Accuracy Requirement
description: Staff must handle all transactions with accuracy as a continuous operational obligation during business hours.

name: KYC/AML Procedure Compliance for New Accounts
canonical_name: KYC/AML Procedure Compliance for New Accounts
description: Staff must follow KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) procedures for all new account openings as a continuous compliance obligation.
context: Follow KYC/AML procedures for new accounts

name: KYC/AML Procedures for New Accounts
description: Know Your Customer and Anti-Money Laundering verification procedures that must be followed when opening new customer accounts during business hours operations.
context: Follow KYC/AML procedures for new accounts

name: Closing Procedures
description: A mandatory end-of-day operational procedure executed at 17:00 PM requiring staff to manage customer admissions, secure cash, shut down systems, and physically close the branch. The procedure includes specific checkpoints for cash reconciliation, system verification, and security protocols, with manager sign-off required to confirm proper closure and cash reconciliation.
context: Do not start new transactions after 16:55 PM
Manager Sign-Off: Verify branch closed properly and all cash reconciled
consequence_of_failure: security breach, cash discrepancy, compliance violation

name: Cash Collection and Verification
description: A mandatory cash handling procedure requiring staff to collect cash from all teller drawers, count and verify against previous count, secure in vault, and record closing balance. For amounts exceeding £10,000, cash must be counted, sealed, and prepared for night deposit.
context: Collect cash from all teller drawers
Count and verify (must match previous count)
Count and seal cash for night deposit (if >£10,000)
timeframe: during last 30 minutes of branch operation
required_action: collect cash from all teller drawers
count and verify against previous count
count and seal cash for night deposit if exceeds £10,000

name: System Shutdown and Data Security
description: A mandatory procedure requiring staff to log out of all customer systems, verify no transactions are pending, shut down computers gracefully, and confirm no sensitive data remains visible on screens before branch closure.
context: Log out of all customer systems
Verify no sensitive data on screens
applies_to: all branch staff with system access
required_action: log out of all customer systems
wait for systems to fully shut down
verify no sensitive data on screens
consequence_of_failure: data breach, unauthorized access, compliance violation

name: Physical Branch Security
description: A mandatory security procedure requiring staff to collect and file customer documents securely, empty and shred trash, lock all office doors, turn off lights, verify entrance/exit doors are locked, and arm the alarm system before departing.
required_action: record closure time and staff names
verification_method: manager verification and alarm system confirmation

name: Last Customer Admission Cutoff
description: A mandatory operational rule prohibiting new customer admissions after 16:55 PM and prohibiting the initiation of new transactions after this time to ensure timely branch closure at 17:00 PM.
context: Do not start new transactions after 16:55 PM
required_action: do not start new transactions after 16:55 PM

name: Manager Closure Verification
description: A mandatory management control requiring the branch manager to verify that the branch has been closed properly and that all cash has been reconciled before the closure process is complete.
context: Manager Sign-Off: Verify branch closed properly and all cash reconciled

name: Closure Documentation
description: A mandatory requirement to record the branch closure time and names of all staff members present during the closing procedure for audit and accountability purposes.
context: Record closure time and staff names
required_action: record closure time and staff names

name: Customer Greeting Upon Arrival
description: Staff must greet customers within 2 minutes of arrival with a standardised welcome phrase, accompanied by appropriate non-verbal communication (smile, eye contact) and an offer of assistance. Staff must also assess and note the customer's emotional state to inform service approach.
context: Greet within 2 minutes: "Good morning/afternoon, welcome to FirstUK Bank"
verification_method: observation during branch audits or mystery shopper visits

name: Customer Greeting and Initial Assessment
description: Staff must demonstrate the ability to greet customers promptly within a 2-minute window, establish rapport through appropriate non-verbal communication, and quickly assess customer emotional state and urgency to tailor service delivery.
context: Greet within 2 minutes: "Good morning/afternoon, welcome to FirstUK Bank"
objective_statement: Staff will be able to greet customers warmly within 2 minutes of arrival, make appropriate eye contact, and assess customer mood and urgency

name: Waiting Customer Management Script
description: A call centre script for managing customer wait times in-branch or on phone. The script provides tiered responses based on wait duration: apologies and refreshment offers for waits exceeding 5 minutes, and escalation to manager or callback scheduling for waits exceeding 15 minutes.
context: If Wait > 5 Minutes: Apologize: 'Sorry for the wait, we'll be with you shortly'
Offer refreshment: 'Can I get you a coffee or water?'
If Wait > 15 Minutes: Escalate to manager
key_content: Escalate to manager if wait exceeds 15 minutes

name: Wait Duration Threshold
description: A dynamic variable representing the elapsed wait time in minutes, used to trigger different customer service responses at 5-minute and 15-minute thresholds.

name: Estimated Time to Service
description: A dynamic variable representing the estimated remaining wait time provided to the customer during extended waits, used in the script to keep customers informed.

name: Customer Contact Information
description: Customer contact details collected for callback purposes when wait times exceed 15 minutes and the customer opts for a scheduled appointment or deferred service.

name: Handling Difficult Customers — Angry Customer
description: A training module covering staff procedures for managing interactions with angry or frustrated customers. The module outlines a five-step de-escalation approach: listening without interruption, acknowledging emotion, apologizing, explaining next steps, and following through immediately.
context: Acknowledge their emotion: 'I understand you're frustrated'
Apologize: 'I'm sorry we let you down'
Explain next steps: 'Here's what we'll do...'

name: Listen to Customer Without Interruption
description: Staff must demonstrate the ability to listen actively to an angry or frustrated customer without interrupting, as the first step in de-escalation.
objective_statement: Staff will listen to customer complaints without interrupting

name: Acknowledge Customer Emotion
description: Staff must be able to recognize and verbally acknowledge a customer's emotional state, using empathetic language such as 'I understand you're frustrated'.
context: Acknowledge their emotion: 'I understand you're frustrated'
objective_statement: Staff will recognize and verbally acknowledge customer frustration or distress

name: Apologize for Service Failure
description: Staff must be able to deliver a sincere apology when the bank has failed to meet customer expectations, using language such as 'I'm sorry we let you down'.
context: Apologize: 'I'm sorry we let you down'
objective_statement: Staff will offer a sincere apology when service has fallen short

name: Explain Next Steps to Customer
description: Staff must be able to clearly communicate the resolution plan or next actions to the customer in a structured manner.
context: Explain next steps: 'Here's what we'll do...'
objective_statement: Staff will clearly communicate the resolution plan to the customer

name: Follow Through on Commitments
description: Staff must demonstrate the ability to execute promised actions immediately and reliably to restore customer confidence.
objective_statement: Staff will execute promised actions immediately and reliably

name: Customer Raises Voice or Uses Profanity
canonical_name: Customer Raises Voice or Uses Profanity
description: A behavioral escalation indicator that signals a customer interaction has become hostile or abusive, requiring immediate manager intervention and transaction suspension.
context: Customer raises voice or uses profanity

name: Complaint Involves Amount Exceeding £1,000
description: A financial threshold trigger indicating that a customer complaint or dispute involves a material amount (>£1,000), requiring escalation to management and potential compliance review.
required_action: Stop transaction and escalate to manager

name: Customer Requests Manager
description: A customer's explicit request to speak with a manager, indicating dissatisfaction with the current interaction and requiring immediate escalation.

name: Regulatory or Compliance Issue Identified
description: A customer interaction or complaint that involves potential regulatory breach, data protection violation, or compliance failure, requiring immediate escalation and investigation.
required_action: Stop transaction and escalate to manager

name: Potential Fraud Detected
description: An indicator that a customer interaction or transaction may involve fraudulent activity, requiring immediate transaction suspension and manager escalation.
required_action: Stop transaction and escalate to manager

name: Stop Transaction on Escalation Trigger
description: Staff must immediately cease processing any transaction when an escalation trigger is identified (raised voice, profanity, high-value complaint, manager request, compliance issue, or fraud suspicion).
required_action: Halt any transaction when an escalation trigger is identified

name: Call Manager Immediately on Escalation
description: Staff must immediately contact a manager when any escalation trigger is identified, without delay or further customer interaction.
required_action: Contact manager without delay when escalation trigger occurs

name: Identity Verification
description: Mandatory verification of customer identity during account opening in branch. Staff must request and examine original photo ID (UK Passport or Driving License), check for validity and tampering, photocopy and file the document, and record the verification outcome in the system.
context: Request photo ID (UK Passport or Driving License)
verification_method: original photo ID examination (UK Passport or Driving License), photocopy and file

name: Address Verification
description: Mandatory verification of customer address during account opening. Staff must request proof of address documentation (utility bill, council tax statement, or bank statement), photocopy and file the document as part of KYC compliance.
context: Request proof of address (utility bill, council tax, bank statement)
verification_method: proof of address document (utility bill, council tax, bank statement), photocopy and file

name: OFAC/EU/HMT Screening
description: Mandatory AML screening process executed during account opening in branch. Customer must be run through OFAC, EU, and HMT screening lists. Results must be documented, and any hit must be escalated immediately to Compliance.
hit_or_match_response: escalate to Compliance if hit detected

name: New Account
description: A customer account created during the in-branch account opening process. The account is created by teller input into the system, assigned a unique account number, and provided with a welcome pack and debit card application option.

name: Individual Customer
description: A natural person applying to open a new account in branch. The customer provides personal information (full name, DOB, address, phone, email), undergoes KYC verification and AML screening, and receives account opening documentation and card services.
context: Collect: Full name, DOB, address, phone, email

name: Debit Card
description: A debit card offered to customers during account opening. The card application is provided to customers, with a 3–5 day delivery timeline explained. Card features and security are explained to the customer.
context: If card ordered: Show 3–5 day timeline
block_or_replacement_conditions: offered at account opening; 3–5 day delivery timeline

name: Customer Full Name
description: A template variable representing the customer's full name, collected during the application step of account opening and used in system records and welcome documentation.
context: Collect: Full name, DOB, address, phone, email

name: Customer Date of Birth
description: A template variable representing the customer's date of birth, collected during the application step and used for identity verification and system records.
context: Collect: Full name, DOB, address, phone, email

name: Customer Address
description: A template variable representing the customer's residential address, collected during application and verified through proof of address documentation.
context: Collect: Full name, DOB, address, phone, email
Request proof of address (utility bill, council tax, bank statement)

name: Customer Phone Number
description: A template variable representing the customer's phone number, collected during the application step for contact and account management purposes.
context: Collect: Full name, DOB, address, phone, email

name: Customer Email Address
description: A template variable representing the customer's email address, collected during the application step for online banking and account communications.
context: Collect: Full name, DOB, address, phone, email

name: Account Number
description: A template variable representing the unique account number generated by the system during account creation, provided to the customer in the welcome pack.

name: Identity Document Type
description: A template variable representing the type of photo ID provided by the customer (UK Passport or Driving License), recorded in the verification outcome.
context: Request photo ID (UK Passport or Driving License)

name: Identity Document Number
description: A template variable representing the document number from the customer's photo ID, recorded as part of the identity verification outcome.

name: Online Banking Initial Password
description: A template variable representing the initial password provided to the customer for online banking access during account closing.

name: KYC Documentation Collection and Filing
description: Mandatory obligation to collect, photocopy, and file both identity and address verification documents during account opening. Staff must retain copies of photo ID and proof of address as part of KYC compliance.
context: Request proof of address (utility bill, council tax, bank statement)
applies_to: all branch staff conducting account openings
consequence_of_failure: account opening cannot be completed; regulatory breach
verification_method: photocopy and file identity and address documents

name: AML Screening Result Documentation
description: Mandatory obligation to document the outcome of AML screening (OFAC/EU/HMT) for every new account opened. Results must be recorded in the system.
applies_to: all branch staff conducting account openings

name: AML Screening Hit Escalation
description: Mandatory obligation to immediately escalate any positive hit from AML screening to the Compliance department. No account may be opened if a screening hit is not cleared by Compliance.

name: Identity Document Authenticity Check
description: Mandatory obligation to examine the original photo ID document for validity and signs of tampering before accepting it as proof of identity during account opening.
applies_to: all branch staff conducting KYC verification
consequence_of_failure: KYC failure; account opening rejection; regulatory breach
verification_method: examine original document for validity and tampering signs

name: Cash Deposit Transaction
description: A cash deposit transaction processed at a branch where customer cash (notes and coins) is counted, verified, and credited to the customer's account. Deposits exceeding £1,000 trigger suspicious activity reporting obligations.
context: Count cash in front of customer
Acceptable Cash: Notes and coins in any condition
Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 in cash (file CTR, see compliance)
process_step: Count cash in front of customer

name: Large Cash Deposit Exceeding Threshold
description: A cash deposit exceeding £1,000 is flagged as suspicious activity requiring CTR (Cash Transaction Report) filing and compliance escalation. This threshold-based indicator is a standard AML monitoring control.
context: Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 in cash (file CTR, see compliance)

name: Cash Transaction Report Filing Obligation
description: Staff must file a Cash Transaction Report (CTR) when a cash deposit exceeds £1,000. This is a mandatory AML reporting duty triggered by the suspicious activity threshold.
context: Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 in cash (file CTR, see compliance)

name: Cash Withdrawal Process
description: Operational procedure for processing customer cash withdrawals, including identity verification, fund confirmation, limit enforcement, and receipt provision. Withdrawals above £5,000 require manager approval and advance notice.
context: Verify customer identity (account card or ID)
Withdrawal limit: £5,000 max (above requires manager approval + notice)
process_steps: Verify customer identity (account card or ID)

name: Customer
description: Individual customer initiating a cash withdrawal transaction, subject to identity verification and account fund checks.
context: Verify customer identity (account card or ID)
verification_requirement: identity verification via account card or ID

name: Cash Withdrawal Transaction
description: A cash withdrawal transaction from a customer account, subject to a £5,000 standard limit and suspicious activity monitoring for amounts exceeding £1,000.
context: Withdrawal limit: £5,000 max (above requires manager approval + notice)
Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 withdrawal (file CTR, see compliance)
threshold_trigger: CTR filing required if amount exceeds £1,000

name: Large Cash Withdrawal Exceeding Threshold
description: Cash withdrawal exceeding £1,000 triggers suspicious activity reporting requirements. Staff must file a Cash Transaction Report (CTR) and escalate to compliance for review.
context: Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 withdrawal (file CTR, see compliance)

name: Cash Withdrawal Limit Enforcement
description: Requirement to enforce a maximum cash withdrawal limit of £5,000 per transaction. Withdrawals above this threshold require manager approval and advance customer notice.
context: Withdrawal limit: £5,000 max (above requires manager approval + notice)
verification_method: manager approval and customer notice required for amounts exceeding £5,000

name: Cash Transaction Report Filing Obligation
description: Mandatory obligation to file a Cash Transaction Report (CTR) when a customer withdraws more than £1,000 in cash, as part of anti-money laundering compliance.
context: Suspicious Activity: >£1,000 withdrawal (file CTR, see compliance)

name: Account Closure
description: The process of closing a customer account, involving identity verification, closure confirmation, final balance calculation including pending interest and fees, statement printing, payout arrangement, system deactivation, and provision of a closure receipt to the customer.
closure_or_freeze_conditions: Customer-initiated closure following identity verification and final balance settlement

name: Customer Identity Verification
description: The first step in the account closure process requiring staff to verify the customer's identity before proceeding with closure confirmation and final settlement.
verification_method: identity verification check performed as first step in closure process
consequence_of_failure: account closure cannot proceed without successful verification

name: Account Closure Confirmation Obligation
description: The requirement to confirm the customer's closure request as part of the account closure process, ensuring explicit consent before proceeding with deactivation.
required_action: confirm closure request with customer following identity verification

name: Final Balance Calculation Obligation
description: The requirement to calculate the final account balance during closure, accounting for pending interest accruals and any outstanding fees owed by the customer.
required_action: calculate final balance accounting for pending interest and fees

name: Final Statement Provision Obligation
description: The requirement to print and provide a final statement to the customer as part of the account closure process, documenting the account's final state.
required_action: print and provide final statement to customer

name: Account Payout Arrangement Obligation
description: The requirement to arrange a payout method for the customer's final balance during account closure, offering options including transfer, cheque, or cash.
required_action: arrange payout method with customer (transfer, cheque, or cash)

name: Account Deactivation Obligation
description: The requirement to deactivate the customer account in the bank's system as part of the formal closure process, preventing further transactions.

name: Closure Receipt Provision Obligation
description: The requirement to provide the customer with a closure receipt documenting the completion of the account closure process.

name: Standing Order Setup
description: The operational process for establishing a new standing order on a customer account. Involves collection of recipient details, confirmation of payment parameters, system entry, and generation of customer confirmation and receipt.
context: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)
setup_or_amendment_process: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)
beneficiary_validation: name, account number, sort code required

name: Recipient Details
description: The payee or recipient information required to set up a standing order, comprising name, account number, and sort code.
context: Obtain recipient details (name, account number, sort code)

name: Payment Amount
description: The monetary value to be transferred in each standing order payment, confirmed during setup.

name: Payment Frequency
description: The recurring interval at which standing order payments are to be made, confirmed during setup.

name: Start Date
description: The date on which the standing order is to commence, confirmed during setup.

name: Direct Debit Mandate Collection
description: The operational process for collecting and establishing a direct debit mandate on a customer account. Involves obtaining a signed mandate form, verifying account and biller details, secure filing, automated biller notification, and provision of a customer copy.

name: Account Details
description: Customer account information that must be verified as part of the direct debit mandate collection process to ensure accuracy and prevent errors.

name: Biller DDIC
description: The Direct Debit Information Centre identifier for the biller that must be verified during mandate collection to ensure the correct creditor is set up.

name: Signed DD Mandate Form Requirement
description: The requirement to obtain a signed direct debit mandate form from the customer as the first step in establishing a direct debit arrangement.

name: Secure Mandate Filing Requirement
description: The requirement to file the direct debit mandate securely after verification to maintain the integrity and confidentiality of the mandate documentation.

name: Biller Notification Obligation
description: The requirement to notify the biller of mandate receipt through an automated process as part of the direct debit setup workflow.

name: Customer Copy Provision Requirement
description: The requirement to provide the customer with a copy of the direct debit mandate for their records and reference.

name: Vault Access Control
description: Staff must ensure vault access is restricted to manager only, enforce two-person rule for vault entry, and never leave vault unattended. Cash counting must occur on secure counter, not at desk.
context: Count cash on secure counter (not desk)

name: Teller Drawer Security
description: Teller drawers must be locked when the teller is absent, counted daily, and any discrepancies must be reported immediately to management.

name: Large Deposit and Withdrawal Approval
description: Deposits and withdrawals exceeding £1,000 require manager approval; those exceeding £5,000 require CTR form filing; those exceeding £10,000 require internal controls check.
verification_method: approval documentation, CTR filing, internal audit

name: Unattended Vault
description: A vault left open and unattended represents a critical security breach and cash loss risk that must be prevented through strict procedural enforcement.
required_action: Never leave vault open unattended; ensure two-person rule is maintained

name: Teller Drawer Discrepancy
description: Discrepancies in daily teller drawer counts are a red flag for potential theft, error, or fraud and must be reported immediately.

name: Customer Data Security Obligation
description: Staff must protect customer personal information and system access through physical security, document handling, and access control measures. This includes never discussing customer information in public, securing physical documents, and maintaining system security protocols.
context: Never discuss on phone where customers can hear
File customer documents in locked cabinet
Shred documents when no longer needed
requirement: file customer documents in locked cabinet
shred documents when no longer needed
never discuss customer information where customers can hear

name: System Access Security Obligation
description: Staff must maintain system security by logging out when leaving their desk, never sharing passwords, and locking computers when absent. Suspicious activity must be reported immediately.

name: Suspicious Activity Reporting Obligation
description: Staff must report suspicious activity immediately upon detection. This is a mandatory escalation duty for any security concerns related to system access or data handling.

name: Unattended Customer Documents Left on Desk
canonical_name: Unattended Customer Documents Left on Desk
key: unattended customer documents left on desk|WARNING_SIGN|banking.communications
description: Customer documents left visible on a desk represent a data protection risk and breach of security protocols. This is a warning sign that physical document security controls are not being followed.
required_action: file documents in locked cabinet immediately

name: Unattended Unlocked Computer
description: An unlocked computer left unattended represents a risk of unauthorized system access and potential data breach. Staff must lock computers when absent to prevent this security concern.
required_action: lock computer immediately when leaving desk

name: Public Discussion of Customer Information
description: Discussing customer information on the phone in a location where customers can overhear represents a confidentiality breach and data protection violation. This is a warning sign of improper information handling.
context: Never discuss on phone where customers can hear
required_action: cease discussion immediately and move to private location

name: Customer Unusually Nervous or Evasive Behaviour
canonical_name: Customer Unusually Nervous or Evasive Behaviour
description: A behavioural red flag indicating a customer displaying signs of nervousness or evasiveness during banking interactions. Staff are trained to recognise this as a potential fraud or misconduct signal requiring further investigation.

name: Request for Large Unusual Transaction
description: A transaction request that is unusually large or out of character for the customer's normal account activity. Staff must recognise this as a potential fraud indicator requiring verification and escalation.

name: Multiple Accounts Used for Same Purpose
canonical_name: Multiple Accounts Used for Same Purpose
description: A pattern where a customer uses multiple accounts to conduct what appears to be the same transaction or purpose. This may indicate account structuring or layering activity and requires investigation.
context: Using multiple accounts for same purpose

name: Inconsistent Personal Information
description: Discrepancies or contradictions in the personal information provided by a customer across interactions or documentation. Staff must flag this as a potential KYC verification failure or identity fraud indicator.

name: Third Party Insisting Customer Transfer Funds
canonical_name: Third Party Insisting Customer Transfer Funds
key: third party insisting customer transfer funds|WARNING_SIGN|banking.communications
description: A scenario where a third party is present or exerting pressure on a customer to transfer funds. This is a strong indicator of potential fraud, account takeover, or financial coercion requiring immediate escalation.
context: Third party insisting customer transfer funds

name: Fraud Detection Questioning and Escalation Obligation
canonical_name: Fraud Detection Questioning and Escalation Obligation
description: Staff must politely ask clarifying questions when fraud red flags are observed, and escalate concerns to a manager or compliance function if suspicion is raised. This is a mandatory action to prevent fraud and meet regulatory obligations.
context: Action: Politely ask questions, escalate to manager/compliance if concerned
required_action: Politely ask questions and escalate to manager or compliance if concerned

name: Customer Communication Best Practice
description: Staff must follow specific communication protocols when interacting with customers, including speaking clearly while facing the customer, allowing extra time for older or vulnerable customers, using plain language without jargon, offering written information, and arranging interpreters when needed. These practices ensure accessibility and clarity in all customer interactions.
context: Allow extra time for older/vulnerable customers
verification_method: staff training and quality assurance monitoring

name: Clear Speech and Customer Engagement
description: Staff must speak clearly and maintain face-to-face engagement with customers during interactions to ensure effective communication and customer understanding.
required_action: speak clearly and face customer during interactions

name: Accessibility for Older and Vulnerable Customers
canonical_name: Accessibility for Older and Vulnerable Customers
description: Staff must allow additional time when communicating with older customers or those identified as vulnerable to ensure they have adequate opportunity to understand information and ask questions.
context: Allow extra time for older/vulnerable customers
required_action: allow extra time for older and vulnerable customers

name: Plain Language Communication
description: Staff must use plain language in all customer communications and avoid technical jargon to ensure customers can understand information clearly and make informed decisions.

name: Written Information Provision
description: Staff must offer written information to customers as part of standard communication practice to provide customers with documentation they can retain and review.

name: Interpreter Arrangement
description: Staff must arrange for an interpreter when needed to ensure customers with language barriers can communicate effectively and understand banking information and services.

name: Language Barrier

name: Greeting Time Standard
description: Staff must greet customers within 2 minutes of their arrival or contact. This is a performance standard that ensures timely customer engagement and service initiation.

name: Transaction Resolution Time Standard
description: Staff must resolve customer transactions within 15 minutes. This performance standard ensures efficient service delivery and customer satisfaction.

name: Queue Time Management Standard
description: Staff must maintain average queue times below 10 minutes. This operational standard ensures customers do not experience excessive wait times.

name: Transaction Accuracy Requirement
description: Staff must maintain transaction accuracy above 99.9%. This is a critical operational control to ensure financial accuracy and customer trust.

name: Cash Drawer Reconciliation Requirement
description: Staff must maintain zero discrepancies in cash drawer reconciliation. This is a mandatory control to prevent cash handling errors and fraud.

name: KYC Completion Obligation
description: Staff must complete KYC verification for 100% of applicable customers. This is a regulatory requirement to ensure proper customer identification and due diligence.

name: AML Screening Completion Obligation
description: Staff must complete AML screening for 100% of transactions or customers as required. This is a regulatory requirement to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing.

name: Fraud and Security Incident Reporting Obligation
canonical_name: Fraud and Security Incident Reporting Obligation
description: Staff must report all fraud and security incidents within 24 hours. This is a mandatory escalation duty to ensure timely investigation and mitigation.

name: Customer Data Breach Reporting Obligation
description: Staff must report customer data breaches immediately upon discovery. This is a critical regulatory and operational obligation to protect customer information.

name: Vault Discrepancy Control
description: Staff must maintain zero tolerance for vault discrepancies. This is a critical security and financial control to prevent loss or theft of assets.

name: Suspicious Transaction Reporting Obligation
description: Staff must report 100% of suspicious transactions. This is a mandatory AML compliance obligation to identify and escalate potentially illicit activity.

name: Customer Satisfaction Standard
description: Staff must achieve and maintain customer satisfaction above 90%. This performance metric ensures service quality and customer retention.

name: Technical Problem Escalation
description: Staff must escalate technical problems to the IT Help Desk at extension 5000. This is a first-line escalation pathway for operational issues affecting service delivery.
context: Technical problem | IT Help Desk | ext. 5000

name: Customer Dispute Escalation Above Threshold
description: Staff must escalate customer disputes exceeding £1,000 to the Area Manager at extension 5001. This establishes a threshold-based escalation control for dispute resolution.

name: Fraud and AML Concern Escalation
description: Staff must immediately escalate any fraud or AML concerns to the Compliance team at extension 5010. This is a mandatory escalation pathway for regulatory and financial crime risks.

name: Security Breach Escalation
description: Staff must escalate any security breach to the Security team at extension 5020. This is a critical escalation pathway for data protection and information security incidents.
